propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple cohesive lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) that must be extracted into a private policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() bypass, requiring introduction of a narrow supported mutation seam
Lifecycle policy owner must preserve at-most-one identity invariant via targeted single-key reverse pops under existing state combinations without detecting or refusing ambiguity
Public facade must retain all existing method signatures and all_bindings() shallow semantics while coordinating the lifecycle owner and repository unit-of-work
Comment IDs must remain append-only, tombstoned issues must suppress recreate until explicit unretire, and confirmed 404 grace/reset and numeric-ID repair must preserve current failure choices
Rich-emission operation must match current hash/counter/save behavior while treating missing bindings as nonfatal
